'''Junior counselor''' was an elected position on the [[Hedrett Council]], the governing body of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. At any one [[Time/Legends|time]], there were twelve junior counselors on the council, and their votes counted for half as much as those of the council's nine [[Senior Counselor|senior counselors]]. During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the former criminal [[Westa Impeveri]] served as a junior counselor, until he later defeated the council leader [[Karid Blakken]] in an [[Hedrett Senior Counselor election, 33 BBY|election]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] and became a senior counselor.
